welcome.title: A note from the Chief Warden
welcome.portraitAlt: Illustrated placeholder portrait of the Chief Warden
welcome.placeholder: Illustrative placeholder. Fictional name and portrait.
welcome.p1: A mess is the one place on campus where everyone meets every day. It should feel dependable: food on time, a clear menu, and a fair wait.
welcome.p2: RAM is how we are working towards that. Digital tokens replace paper, menus and timings are public, and the improvements we make are posted where you can see them.
welcome.p3: If something can be done better, tell us. We would rather hear it early.
welcome.name: Dr. Raghavendra Iyer

initiatives.title: Five initiatives, in plain terms
initiatives.lead: These are the directions the Chief Warden's office is pursuing. Progress is reported openly in the daily progress board below.

paper.title: Zero Paper Tokens
paper.desc: Meal tokens live on your phone. No printed slips to buy, lose or throw away, and no queue at the token window.

waste.title: Food Waste Reduction
waste.desc: Counting who eats helps kitchens cook closer to real demand, so less good food ends up in the bin.

grab.title: Grab & Go
grab.desc: A quicker lane for simple, ready items when you are between classes.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.desc: Menus, timings and improvements are public, and we show our figures with their limits.

wellness.title: Wellness
wellness.desc: Balanced plates, fresh vegetables and lighter options on every menu.

map.title: Messes on campus
map.lead: Select a pin to jump to that mess's details, or select a mess in the list to find it on the map.
map.todo: Pin positions are placeholders until the Chief Warden's office confirms exact locations.

messSections.title: What each mess offers
messSections.lead: Menu style, who can eat where, meal times, today's menu and the latest improvement for every confirmed mess. Details marked demo data are placeholders until verified.
messSections.photoNote: Illustrative food photo, not this mess.
messSections.othersLead: These messes exist but their names and details are not yet confirmed, so they are listed plainly and without guesses.

token.title: My meal QR
token.subtitle: Show this code at the counter. It changes every 30 seconds and works without internet.
token.enrollBody: Your phone creates a private key that never leaves it. Only the matching public key is sent to RAM. You can have one active phone at a time.
token.otherDevice: Another phone ({label}) is your active device. Enrolling here will replace it.
token.replacedTitle: This phone is no longer active
token.replacedBody: Another phone was enrolled, or this one was revoked. Set this phone up again to use it.
token.offlineOk: You are offline. The QR still works.
token.clockOff: Your phone's clock is {seconds} s off. RAM is correcting for it while you are online, but please turn on automatic date and time.
token.tipBrightness: Raise your screen brightness so the counter can scan it.
token.tipScreenshot: Screenshots stop working within a minute, so don't share this code.
token.signFailed: Could not create the code. Set this phone up again.

errors.reauth_required: For safety, sign in again first, then come back and set up this phone.
errors.rate_limited: You have set up phones too many times today. Try again tomorrow or ask the warden's office.
errors.not_student: Only students can set up a meal QR.
errors.invalid_key: This browser could not create a valid key. Try another browser.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
